description: This file declares functions related to URL processing, including detection, decoding, and handling URL components and encoding schemes.

methods.name: is_url
methods.description: Checks if a given string is a valid URL.

methods.name: is_urlschemechar
methods.description: Determines if a character is valid within a URL scheme.

methods.name: url_decode_mem
methods.description: Decodes percent-encoded URL string with specified length.

methods.name: url_percent_decode
methods.description: Decodes percent-encoded sequences before the first colon or in absence of a scheme.

methods.name: url_decode_parameter_name
methods.description: Decodes URL-encoded parameter name from query.

methods.name: url_decode_parameter_value
methods.description: Decodes URL-encoded parameter value from query.

methods.name: end_url_with_slash
methods.description: Appends a slash to the URL in the provided string buffer.

methods.name: str_end_url_with_slash
methods.description: Creates a new string with a slash appended to the URL.
